products.title: SLEEK - 30TH ANNIVERSARY
products.body_html:
Designed for Female Snowboarders Who Demand Trusted High Performance

A high-performance all-round model meticulously balanced to fit perfectly down to the finest details. While prioritizing ease of riding, it delivers sharp, precise carving, high and controlled jumps with stable landings, and confident stability during high-rotation spins.
